_metadata.title: One District One Product (ODOP) Statutory Registry
initiatives: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME - MoFPI)
One District One Product (ODOP - DPIIT Ministry of Commerce & Industry)
State Specific ODOP Notifications (Biswa Bangla, UP ODOP, MP ODOP)
_metadata.research_notes: Ground-truth audited against DPIIT, MoFPI PMFME, and State Industries Department notifications. Bankura's notified ODOP is Terracotta Craft & Dokra (Bishnupur/Panchmura) and Baluchari Silk; dairy is supported under general rural agro schemes but is NOT Bankura's designated ODOP.

Bankura.raw_material_availability: Alluvial red clay of Panchmura & traditional brass-casting wax artisans in Bikna
key_benefits: GI-tagged Bankura Terracotta Horse & Baluchari provenance protection
Access to Bishnupur & Bikna Common Facility Centre (CFC)
GeM ODOP seller portal direct onboarding without minimum turnover criteria
KVIC / SFURTI artisan cluster capital assistance
Bankura.non_odop_guidance: While dairy, rice milling, and agro-processing are major economic activities under the Bankura District Industries Centre (DIC), they are not Bankura's officially designated ODOP items. Dairy units qualify for standard PMEGP (up to 35% capital subsidy) and the general PMFME demand-driven window, but do not receive ODOP-specific cluster privileges.
